setup.why: A fresh git worktree contains only TRACKED files, so node_modules does not exist and the test runner is not installed. NEVER symlink or copy node_modules from another worktree — that checkout is on a different branch with a different lockfile, and your green anchors would describe a build that does not exist. A clean install takes ~8 seconds.

lanes.why: forward-only numbering — two agents cannot both mint the next migration number, and no merge can resolve that collision

pairedArtifacts.help: Read web/test/README.md and copy the pattern that matches: a controlled component with no local state, one driven by the keyboard, or one with a server action inside useTransition.

git.denyPushReason:
BLOCKED: git push is denied for AI agents on this project.

Staging and committing are allowed; publishing is not, in any form.

The gate before any push is: build -> test -> commit -> merge forward -> deploy locally -> a human verifies the RUNNING APP by hand. They perform the push.

If a push is genuinely required, say so and stop. Do not work around this.
